profile.headline: Software Engineer at Pendo.io
profile.summary:
I enjoy being a Software Engineer at Pendo, I love the collaboration and culture at Pendo. 

As a graduate of Lambda School (https://lambdaschool.com/) I spent much of 2020 refining my programming skills. Over the course of the year, I have gone from a basic understanding of programming and computer science theory to building a React application from scratch, as well as having worked on a wide variety of Agile teams to deliver digital products under tight deadlines. 

In addition to Lambda School, I have received my B.S. in Computer Science at Oregon State University in April 2021.

Prior to becoming a software developer, I spend three years as a Registered Dental Hygienist, having graduated from the University of Michigan in 2016 with a bachelor's degree in dental hygiene.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Create dynamic learning experiences for the next generation of software engineers by deploying instructional best practices that are student-centered and designed to meet the needs of adult learners. Support students through exercises designed to build knowledge and skills.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description: Work on a cross-functional team of 10 to deliver a fully functioning application that help kids get interested in reading, writing and drawing

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description:
•Serve as a mentor, resource, and leader for students pursuing full stack web development in a small group setting.
•Provided daily feedback and issue resolution of all curriculum through slack help channel or code review 
•Delivered one-on-one feedback and code review on a weekly basis 
•Led a team of 8 students in an Agile methodology environment 
•Facilitated daily stand-ups which promoted team collaboration, promoted sharing of ideas and work progress and provided guidance for the week's learning material
•Delivered supplemental lectures on various topics related to software engineering
•Reports to a Section Lead (SL) and Lambda Student Leadership staff.

positions.title: Registered Dental Hygienist
positions.description:
•Implemented nightly back-ups of the data in the system to reduce the images lost by 90% within 3 months.
•Customized healthcare plans for each patient which helped to improve their oral health by 80%. 
•Collaborated with a team of 5 cross-functional dental professions to provide excellent patient care. 
•Improved and developed knowledge through continuing education courses and seminars

projects.title: Human Rights Considered
projects.description:
Collaborated with a stakeholder (Human Rights First Advocacy organization) to develop a visualization that showcases instances of police use of force along with a data science model that helps classify possible instances of brutality. 

React | Redux | Node Js | Express Js | AWS | DS

• Tested previous API and optimized based on testing with a team of 7
• Implemented new tables to the database to streamline the data being sent to the front end 
• Co-ordinated solutions to solve the problems of the stakeholder with a cross functional team of 65 engineers

projects.title: Better Professor App
projects.description:
API Documentation Link: https://backend-build-week.vercel.app/

Allows professors to stay on track of class and graduate student schedules.

React | Redux | Node Js | Express Js

•Constructed a backend API utilizing Node JS and Express JS within 1 week
•Communicated with a remote team of 3 cross-functional software developers 
•Designed 100% of unit and endpoint testing via Jest
•Resolved  the needs of an external stakeholder to create an fully functional application which increased user traffic by 200%
